add_role: Grant a role to a member
announce: Post a formatted announcement in a channel
autonomy: Enable or disable Angel's autonomous engagement
autorole: Set the role granted automatically to every new member
ban: Ban a member from the server
budget: Show Angel's model budget usage for the day
chat: Talk to Angel, optionally with an image or GIF attached
cleanup: Clear the bot's temporary files and trash storage
custom_action: Bind a phrase to an automatic moderation action
data: Show what the bot stores about you, or delete it
diagnostics: Full health check of the system, connection and models
dm_logs: Read the incoming direct message log
dm_send: Send a direct message through the bot
editsnipe: Reveal the last edited message in the channel
fix: View a TikTok or Instagram video or photo album
giveaway: Start an interactive giveaway in the channel
guard: Manage the smart protection and anti-spam system
harem: Manage the list of close members
imagine: Generate an artwork through Angel Studio
kick: Kick a member from the server
knowledge: Manage the server knowledge base of rules and answers
leaderboard: Show the most active members in the server
lock: Lock the channel so members cannot post
lore: A short profile of Angel's character
memory: Memory vault: view, pin a lasting note, or forget one
play: Play a track or a playlist from a link or a search
playlist: Save, browse or delete a playlist
poll: Create a poll in the channel
pulse: Show the server pulse board and activity indicators
purge: Delete a number of messages in the channel
rank: Show your level, rank and reputation points
remove_role: Remove a role from a member
rep: Give a member a reputation point
rules: Ask Angel about the server rules, answered from the indexed rules
silence: Stop Angel from speaking in a channel or the whole server
snipe: Reveal the last deleted message in the channel
sticky: Pin a smart message that stays at the bottom of the channel
summarize_channel: Read and summarise the recent channel conversation
sync: Synchronise and refresh the command tree
translate: Translate any text into another language
unban: Unban a user by their ID
untimeout: Remove the timeout from a member
warn: Issue a warning to a member
whisper: Send a direct message through the bot in the current conversation
اقتراح رد ومهام: Suggest a reply and follow-up tasks for a message
ترجمة وتحليل: Translate a message and explain its meaning
تلخيص الرسالة: Summarise a message into key points
setup: Configure Angel for this server (dialect, guard level, link fixer)
catchup: Summarise the recent messages you missed in this channel
